strengths: Denominator discipline is exemplary: six estimands, six denominators, the 26-cell unaided set enumerated cell-by-cell in panel.yaml and never pooled with the 7-cell category-aided or 7-cell target-aided sets, with a counts-not-percentages rule for strata under 20–30 cells.

Honest treatment of the weakest area: edge compute appears in the user's own description but is held at icp-005 hypothesis_only, job-010 with null struggling_moment, cells 044/045 quarantined, src-016 declared as llm_hypothesis grade D, and waiver-06 states the evidence needed.

Counterevidence is preserved and operationalised — the 2025-11-18 outage (src-013) is registered as counterevidence to the availability standing claim and generates cells 006/011/027 rather than being dropped.

Contamination handling avoids both leakage and false positives: ambiguous_terms (CDN, WAF, ZTNA, 'bot management') are routed to review with 12 clearances recorded, hard-fail scope is defined, auto_delete is prohibited, and three rejects are archived with reasons.

Genuine measurement design: matched-unaffected control cells (048/049) in a domain with no target standing, fresh-session-per-observation, live-vs-cached retrieval state, cluster bootstrap on canonical_cell_id, variance pilot specified, and equal weights labelled a convention rather than prevalence.

Failures are surfaced rather than papered over: the rotating partition contributing zero wave-1 observations, procedural-not-architectural blinding, missing hashes/seed, and five Gate 3 disputes are all stated in panel_report.md, tracking_plan.md and panel.yaml.
judge_verdict.summary: A strong, unusually honest URL-only panel. All fourteen artifacts are present, parse and cross-reconcile exactly (50 cells; band, aided, act, journey, role, lane and grade tallies each sum to 50; the 26-cell unaided denominator enumerates precisely the unaided core+sentinel cells), and panel_report.md exposes 92 exact prompt strings with the dimensions needed to track them. Measurement honesty is the standout: six estimands with six separate denominators, aided/unaided and lane pooling explicitly prohibited, exposure and priority weights held apart with an equal-weight convention limitation, prompt-space (not user) population, directional_only precision, campaign_response out of scope, and a rung-1-only claims ladder. Contamination control is thorough without over-blocking — ambiguous category terms are reviewed rather than auto-failed, B0/B5 target-aided cells are quarantined in the aided partition, the single grade-D candidate is confined to rotating, and three rejects are archived with reasons. Against the case gold, four of six must-haves pass and none of the five anti-patterns triggers: CDN, application/DDoS security, Zero Trust/SASE and crawler-control jobs are separated with category-appropriate constraints and answer kinds, six distinct technical and buying roles carry distinct registers, and implementation, migration, verification and post-purchase acts are present alongside comparison. Two gaps hold it back from a higher score. Authoritative DNS — named in the case description and in the charter's own product list — has no job, no cell and no waiver, unlike edge compute which is rigorously waived. And time-sensitivity discipline is applied only to the five B5 cells: plan, pricing, feature and reliability cells built on undated company copy (cell-031, 024, 027, 028) carry no refresh rule, and no service-status cell exists. Smaller defects: src-013 is a vendor postmortem URL classed 'independent'; the whole rotating partition has zero runnable candidates in wave 1; all hashes are 'sha256:unavailable' and the seed is null, so the panel cannot be frozen; and several candidates are labelled variant_role 'observed_language' when the run states nothing was observed. Mean 4.25, no hard-gate failure, no critical contamination, traceability, denominator or causal-claim failure — verdict pass, with the DNS gap and plan/pricing freshness rules as the first repairs.
